round8_promotion_20260914.user_condition: FP32 Gram-Schmidt approved 2026-09-14 on condition of no PSNR difference over 20 videos; measured +0.032 dB (20) / +0.020 dB (5).

round9_selector_v8_20260915.scope: Promoted 2026-09-15 (round 9): the selector is now fisher_c4_selector_v8_ldsm_packed.cu, an exact rewrite of the FP32 GS register-pipelined selector: padded 272-byte shared rows with 24 ldmatrix.x4 fragment loads in place of 96 LDS.32 and their address arithmetic, a branchless local argmax with REDUX cross-lane argmax, hoisted anchor and candidate row, a halved accumulator transpose and one packed 32-bit seed store per frame. Seeds and complete output are bitwise equal to fisher_c4_selector_fp32gs_regpipe.cu on layers 0/19/39 and on the tie edge cases. Registers 124 -> 89, 4 -> 5 CTAs per SM. Selector stage 7.25 -> 5.23 ms (-2.02 ms per call, 90 of 90 paired wins); complete call -1.27 ms (100.29 -> 98.95 ms in the same window, 80 of 90 paired wins). The previous selector stays in this directory as the paired control.

round9_selector_mxredux_20260915.scope: Promoted 2026-09-15 (round 9, third selector step): fisher_c4_selector_v9c_halving_mxredux.cu replaces fisher_c4_selector_v8_ldsm_packed.cu. Exact rewrite of the Gram-Schmidt reductions: recursive-halving reductions for the per-step candidate scores (each probe lane ends with one candidate's score, so the local argmax collapses onto the REDUX cross-lane argmax) and for the 32-candidate centers (probe subset relocated to lane bits 4,3), with the center max taken by REDUX on order-preserving integer keys. Every added FP32 add pairs the same operands as the butterfly it replaces; seeds and complete output are bitwise equal to the previous selector on layers 0/19/39 and on the tie edge cases. SHFL.BFLY 66 -> 41 per frame, registers 89 -> 80, still 5 CTAs per SM. Selector stage 5.26 -> 4.88 ms (-0.374 ms per call, 90 of 90 paired wins, t -19 to -27); complete call -0.29 ms (98.49 -> 98.18 ms in the same window, 55 of 90 - at the complete-call instrument's resolution floor, kept as a no-regression check). The previous selector stays in this directory as the paired control.
